questions.prompt: Who led the nonviolent Salt March in 1930?
questions.fact: The march protested a tax on salt — an ordinary necessity, chosen precisely because it made the injustice legible to everyone.

questions.prompt: Which layer of the atmosphere contains the ozone layer?
questions.fact: It absorbs most ultraviolet light, which is why the hole found over Antarctica prompted a rare and effective global treaty.

questions.prompt: In cricket, how many players are on a team?
questions.fact: Eleven a side, and a match can run five days and still end in a draw.

questions.prompt: Which film won the first Academy Award for Best Animated Feature?
questions.fact: The category was created in 2001, and it beat Monsters, Inc. to take the very first one.

questions.prompt: Which lake is the largest freshwater lake by surface area?
questions.fact: It holds enough water to cover both North and South America to a depth of about a foot.

questions.prompt: Which Shakespeare comedy features the fairy king Oberon?
questions.fact: The play runs three plots at once — lovers, fairies and amateur actors — and ties them together over a single night.

questions.prompt: Which storage type has no moving parts?
questions.fact: No spinning platters means no seek time, which is why it feels instant next to a mechanical drive.
